# Match My Skin by Roopsee

**Match My Skin by Roopsee** is a free AI-powered skincare recommendation platform that helps users discover products suited to their unique skin profile. By answering a short quiz about skin type, sensitivity, concerns, age, and gender, users receive personalized skincare recommendations, product compatibility scores, and complete AM, PM, and weekly skincare routines generated from a continuously updated skincare catalog. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

## Key Pages

- **Skin Match Tool:** https://matchmyskin.roopsee.com/  
  Start the personalized skincare quiz and receive tailored product recommendations.

- **Product Pages:** https://matchmyskin.roopsee.com/products/  
  Explore detailed product information, compatibility scores, ingredients, benefits, and usage instructions.

- **How It Works (FAQ):** https://matchmyskin.roopsee.com/how-it-works  
  Learn how the recommendation engine works, how products are scored, and find answers to frequently asked questions.

## Features

- Personalized skincare quiz
- AI-powered product matching
- Skin type analysis (Oily, Dry, Combination, Normal)
- Skin concern analysis (Acne, Pigmentation, Dryness, Sensitivity, Dark Spots, etc.)
- Age- and gender-aware recommendations
- Premium and Value skincare routine options
- Product compatibility scoring
- Ingredient and usage guidance
- Live skincare product catalog

## About

Roopsee is an AI-driven skincare recommendation platform designed to simplify skincare decisions. The recommendation engine evaluates multiple factors—including skin type, sensitivity, primary skin concerns, age group, and gender—to calculate a compatibility score for each product. Based on these scores, the platform ranks products and generates personalized skincare routines with both **Premium** and **Value** options, helping users choose products that best match their skin needs.
